facts.text: Can you keep the soup a little further away from me? It smells amazing, but I am made of snow.
facts.why: Olaf's real lines on the Wikiquote page show him loving summer, sun and heat, not keeping away from soup. This line is not on the page.
facts.fix: I've always loved the idea of summer, and sun, and all things hot.
